items.question: Trong câu "Traversal means visiting every node exactly once — to print it, sum it, search it, copy it or delete it.", từ "traversal" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Traversal means visiting every node exactly once — to print it, sum it, search it, copy it or delete it.", what does "traversal" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the act of visiting every item
items.explanation: traversal /trəˈvɜːsl/ (danh từ): sự duyệt qua. Động từ gốc là "traverse"; "tree traversal" = duyệt cây, thăm mỗi nút đúng một lần.
items.explanationEn: traversal /trəˈvɜːsl/ (noun): the act of visiting every item. It comes from the verb "traverse"; "tree traversal" means visiting each node exactly once.

items.question: Trong câu "For an array or a linked list this is trivial: there is one natural order, first to last.", từ "trivial" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For an array or a linked list this is trivial: there is one natural order, first to last.", what does "trivial" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: trivial /ˈtrɪviəl/ (tính từ): dễ, hiển nhiên. "This is trivial" = việc này quá đơn giản, không cần giải thích nhiều.
items.explanationEn: trivial /ˈtrɪviəl/ (adjective): very easy, obvious. "This is trivial" means it is so simple it needs little explanation.

items.question: Trong câu "A tree is non-linear: after visiting a node you may have two (or more) children to go to, and you must decide which branch to explore first and what to remember about the branch you did not take.", từ "non-linear" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A tree is non-linear: after visiting a node you may have two (or more) children to go to, and you must decide which branch to explore first and what to remember about the branch you did not take.", what does "non-linear" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: not arranged in a single line
items.explanation: non-linear /ˌnɒnˈlɪniə(r)/ (tính từ): phi tuyến tính. Mảng và danh sách liên kết là "linear" (một hàng); cây và đồ thị là "non-linear" vì có nhiều hướng đi.
items.explanationEn: non-linear /ˌnɒnˈlɪniə(r)/ (adjective): not arranged in a single line. Arrays and linked lists are "linear"; trees and graphs are "non-linear" because a node can lead several ways.

items.question: Trong câu "A tree is non-linear: after visiting a node you may have two (or more) children to go to, and you must decide which branch to explore first and what to remember about the branch you did not take.", từ "branch" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A tree is non-linear: after visiting a node you may have two (or more) children to go to, and you must decide which branch to explore first and what to remember about the branch you did not take.", what does "branch" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a local office of a company
a small arm of a river
one path splitting off a tree
items.explanation: branch /brɑːntʃ/ (danh từ): nhánh (của cây). "Explore a branch" = đi sâu vào một nhánh; trong Git "branch" cũng là nhánh mã nguồn.
items.explanationEn: branch /brɑːntʃ/ (noun): one path splitting off a tree. "Explore a branch" means going down one path; in Git a "branch" is also a line of code history.

items.question: Trong câu "A tree is non-linear: after visiting a node you may have two (or more) children to go to, and you must decide which branch to explore first and what to remember about the branch you did not take.", từ "explore" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A tree is non-linear: after visiting a node you may have two (or more) children to go to, and you must decide which branch to explore first and what to remember about the branch you did not take.", what does "explore" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: explore /ɪkˈsplɔː(r)/ (động từ): khám phá, đi vào. "Explore first" = đi vào xem trước; thuật toán tìm kiếm "explore" các nhánh chưa thăm.
items.explanationEn: explore /ɪkˈsplɔː(r)/ (verb): to go into and examine. "Explore first" means go into it first; search algorithms explore branches not yet visited.

items.question: Trong câu "Every traversal strategy belongs to one of two families:", từ "strategy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every traversal strategy belongs to one of two families:", what does "strategy" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: strategy /ˈstrætədʒi/ (danh từ): chiến lược, cách làm. "Traversal strategy" = cách chọn thứ tự duyệt; hay gặp "a strategy for doing something".
items.explanationEn: strategy /ˈstrætədʒi/ (noun): a plan or method. "Traversal strategy" is the chosen way to order the visits; common pattern: "a strategy for doing something".

items.question: Trong câu "What differs is the order of the output and the extra memory needed.", từ "differ" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What differs is the order of the output and the extra memory needed.", what does "differ" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: differ /ˈdɪfə(r)/ (động từ): khác nhau. "What differs is…" = điểm khác biệt là…; cụm "differ in" = khác nhau ở điểm nào.
items.explanationEn: differ /ˈdɪfə(r)/ (verb): to be unlike. "What differs is…" names the point of difference; "differ in" says in what way things are unlike.

items.question: Trong câu "What differs is the order of the output and the extra memory needed.", từ "extra" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What differs is the order of the output and the extra memory needed.", what does "extra" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: extra /ˈekstrə/ (tính từ): thêm, bổ sung. "Extra memory" = bộ nhớ dùng thêm ngoài dữ liệu đầu vào.
items.explanationEn: extra /ˈekstrə/ (adjective): additional. "Extra memory" is the memory used on top of the input itself.

items.question: Trong câu "It happens to be a binary search tree (it could be built by inserting 10, 6, 15, 3, 8, 20), but the traversal code works on any binary tree — none of it compares values.", từ "happen to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It happens to be a binary search tree (it could be built by inserting 10, 6, 15, 3, 8, 20), but the traversal code works on any binary tree — none of it compares values.", what does "happen to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: happen to /ˈhæpən tə/ (cụm từ): tình cờ là. "It happens to be a BST" = nó tình cờ cũng là BST, nhưng điều đó không quan trọng ở đây.
items.explanationEn: happen to /ˈhæpən tə/ (phrase): to be so by chance. "It happens to be a BST" means it is one by chance, and that fact is not essential here.

items.question: Trong câu "It happens to be a binary search tree (it could be built by inserting 10, 6, 15, 3, 8, 20), but the traversal code works on any binary tree — none of it compares values.", từ "insert" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It happens to be a binary search tree (it could be built by inserting 10, 6, 15, 3, 8, 20), but the traversal code works on any binary tree — none of it compares values.", what does "insert" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: insert /ɪnˈsɜːt/ (động từ): chèn vào. "Insert a value into a tree" = chèn giá trị vào cây; ngược nghĩa với "remove/delete".
items.explanationEn: insert /ɪnˈsɜːt/ (verb): to put into. "Insert a value into a tree" means adding it at the right place; the opposite of "remove".

items.question: Trong câu "It happens to be a binary search tree (it could be built by inserting 10, 6, 15, 3, 8, 20), but the traversal code works on any binary tree — none of it compares values.", từ "compare" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It happens to be a binary search tree (it could be built by inserting 10, 6, 15, 3, 8, 20), but the traversal code works on any binary tree — none of it compares values.", what does "compare" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: compare /kəmˈpeə(r)/ (động từ): so sánh. "Compare values" = so sánh các giá trị; cụm "compare A with/to B".
items.explanationEn: compare /kəmˈpeə(r)/ (verb): to check how things differ. "Compare values" means checking which is larger or equal; pattern: "compare A with/to B".

items.question: Trong câu "A node only needs a value and two child references:", từ "reference" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A node only needs a value and two child references:", what does "reference" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a book you look things up in
items.explanation: reference /ˈrefrəns/ (danh từ): tham chiếu (trỏ tới). "Child reference" = biến trỏ tới nút con; trong JS, object được truyền bằng tham chiếu.
items.explanationEn: reference /ˈrefrəns/ (noun): a pointer to an object. "Child reference" is a field pointing to a child node; in JS, objects are passed by reference.

items.question: Trong câu "The four traversals of this tree, which the next sections derive:", từ "derive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The four traversals of this tree, which the next sections derive:", what does "derive" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to work out step by step
items.explanation: derive /dɪˈraɪv/ (động từ): suy ra, rút ra. "Derive a result" = suy ra kết quả từng bước; "derived from" = bắt nguồn từ.
items.explanationEn: derive /dɪˈraɪv/ (verb): to work out step by step. "Derive a result" means working it out logically; "derived from" means coming from a source.

items.question: Trong câu "BFS visits all nodes at depth 0, then all at depth 1, then depth 2, and so on.", từ "depth" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BFS visits all nodes at depth 0, then all at depth 1, then depth 2, and so on.", what does "depth" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: depth /depθ/ (danh từ): độ sâu. "At depth 2" = ở độ sâu 2 (cách gốc 2 cạnh); "depth-first" = ưu tiên chiều sâu.
items.explanationEn: depth /depθ/ (noun): how far down something is. "At depth 2" means two edges below the root; "depth-first" means going deep first.

items.question: Trong câu "BFS visits all nodes at depth 0, then all at depth 1, then depth 2, and so on.", từ "and so on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BFS visits all nodes at depth 0, then all at depth 1, then depth 2, and so on.", what does "and so on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: and so on /ənd ˈsəʊ ɒn/ (cụm từ): vân vân, cứ thế. "And so on" đứng cuối một dãy ví dụ, nghĩa là mẫu lặp lại tiếp.
items.explanationEn: and so on /ənd ˈsəʊ ɒn/ (phrase): and continuing the same way. "And so on" ends a list of examples to say the pattern continues.

items.question: Trong câu "The trick is a queue: when you visit a node, you add its children to the back of the queue, and you always take the next node from the front.", từ "trick" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The trick is a queue: when you visit a node, you add its children to the back of the queue, and you always take the next node from the front.", what does "trick" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: trick /trɪk/ (danh từ): mẹo, bí quyết. "The trick is…" = mấu chốt/mẹo là…; "trick" cũng có nghĩa trò lừa, nhưng ở đây là mẹo hay.
items.explanationEn: trick /trɪk/ (noun): a clever way of doing. "The trick is…" introduces the key idea; "trick" can also mean a deception, but not here.

items.question: Trong câu "Children of earlier nodes are therefore always processed before children of later ones.", từ "therefore" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Children of earlier nodes are therefore always processed before children of later ones.", what does "therefore" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: therefore /ˈðeəfɔː(r)/ (trạng từ): do đó, vì vậy. "Therefore" nối kết luận với lý do phía trước, trang trọng hơn "so".
items.explanationEn: therefore /ˈðeəfɔː(r)/ (adverb): as a result. "Therefore" links a conclusion to the reason before it; more formal than "so".

items.question: Trong câu "Children of earlier nodes are therefore always processed before children of later ones.", từ "process" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Children of earlier nodes are therefore always processed before children of later ones.", what does "process" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: process /ˈprəʊses/ (động từ): xử lý. "Process a node" = xử lý một nút; danh từ "process" = tiến trình, quy trình.
items.explanationEn: process /ˈprəʊses/ (verb): to handle or work on. "Process a node" means doing the needed work on it; the noun "process" means a procedure.

items.question: Trong câu "The direct translation uses an array with push / shift:", từ "translation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The direct translation uses an array with push / shift:", what does "translation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: translation /trænsˈleɪʃn/ (danh từ): sự chuyển thành mã. "Direct translation" ở đây = viết thẳng thuật toán thành code; nghĩa phổ biến khác là bản dịch.
items.explanationEn: translation /trænsˈleɪʃn/ (noun): turning an idea into code. "Direct translation" here means writing the algorithm straight into code; it usually means a language translation.

items.question: Trong câu "It is correct, but shift is O(n): every remaining element is re-indexed.", từ "remaining" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is correct, but shift is O(n): every remaining element is re-indexed.", what does "remaining" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: remaining /rɪˈmeɪnɪŋ/ (tính từ): còn lại. "Every remaining element" = mọi phần tử còn lại; động từ gốc "remain".
items.explanationEn: remaining /rɪˈmeɪnɪŋ/ (adjective): still left over. "Every remaining element" means all elements still left; from the verb "remain".

items.question: Trong câu "With a queue that holds up to n/2 nodes, the worst case drifts towards O(n²).", từ "worst case" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With a queue that holds up to n/2 nodes, the worst case drifts towards O(n²).", what does "worst case" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: worst case /ˌwɜːst ˈkeɪs/ (cụm từ): trường hợp xấu nhất. "Worst case O(n²)" = trong tình huống tệ nhất tốn O(n²); đối lập với "best case".
items.explanationEn: worst case /ˌwɜːst ˈkeɪs/ (phrase): the least favourable situation. "Worst case O(n²)" is the cost in the least favourable input; the opposite is "best case".

items.question: Trong câu "With a queue that holds up to n/2 nodes, the worst case drifts towards O(n²).", từ "drift" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With a queue that holds up to n/2 nodes, the worst case drifts towards O(n²).", what does "drift" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: drift /drɪft/ (động từ): dần trôi về. "Drift towards O(n²)" = dần tiến tới O(n²); gốc là trôi dạt theo dòng nước.
items.explanationEn: drift /drɪft/ (verb): to move slowly towards. "Drift towards O(n²)" means gradually getting close to it; literally, to be carried by water.

items.question: Trong câu "With a queue that holds up to n/2 nodes, the worst case drifts towards O(n²).", từ "up to" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With a queue that holds up to n/2 nodes, the worst case drifts towards O(n²).", what does "up to" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: up to /ˈʌp tə/ (giới từ): tối đa là. "Holds up to n/2 nodes" = chứa nhiều nhất n/2 nút; "it is up to you" lại nghĩa là tuỳ bạn.
items.explanationEn: up to /ˈʌp tə/ (preposition): as many as. "Holds up to n/2 nodes" means at most n/2; "it is up to you" means it is your choice.

items.question: Trong câu "Keep a head index instead of shifting (const node = queue[head++]): O(n) time, but the array keeps all n references, so O(n) space.", từ "instead of" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keep a head index instead of shifting (const node = queue[head++]): O(n) time, but the array keeps all n references, so O(n) space.", what does "instead of" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: instead of /ɪnˈsted əv/ (giới từ): thay vì. "Instead of shifting" = thay vì dùng shift; sau "instead of" dùng danh từ hoặc V-ing.
items.explanationEn: instead of /ɪnˈsted əv/ (preposition): in place of. "Instead of shifting" means using another way rather than shift; it takes a noun or -ing form.

items.question: Trong câu "Complexity of BFS: O(n) time (each node enqueued and dequeued once) and O(w) auxiliary space, where w is the maximum width of the tree — the largest number of nodes waiting in the queue at once.", từ "auxiliary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Complexity of BFS: O(n) time (each node enqueued and dequeued once) and O(w) auxiliary space, where w is the maximum width of the tree — the largest number of nodes waiting in the queue at once.", what does "auxiliary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: auxiliary /ɔːɡˈzɪliəri/ (tính từ): phụ, bổ trợ. "Auxiliary space" = bộ nhớ phụ ngoài đầu vào và đầu ra (queue, stack…).
items.explanationEn: auxiliary /ɔːɡˈzɪliəri/ (adjective): extra, helping. "Auxiliary space" is the helper memory beyond input and output, such as a queue or stack.

items.question: Trong câu "Complexity of BFS: O(n) time (each node enqueued and dequeued once) and O(w) auxiliary space, where w is the maximum width of the tree — the largest number of nodes waiting in the queue at once.", từ "width" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Complexity of BFS: O(n) time (each node enqueued and dequeued once) and O(w) auxiliary space, where w is the maximum width of the tree — the largest number of nodes waiting in the queue at once.", what does "width" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: width /wɪdθ/ (danh từ): độ rộng. "Width of a tree" = số nút lớn nhất trên một tầng; tính từ là "wide".
items.explanationEn: width /wɪdθ/ (noun): how wide something is. "Width of a tree" is the largest number of nodes on one level; the adjective is "wide".

items.question: Trong câu "Complexity of BFS: O(n) time (each node enqueued and dequeued once) and O(w) auxiliary space, where w is the maximum width of the tree — the largest number of nodes waiting in the queue at once.", từ "at once" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Complexity of BFS: O(n) time (each node enqueued and dequeued once) and O(w) auxiliary space, where w is the maximum width of the tree — the largest number of nodes waiting in the queue at once.", what does "at once" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at once /ət ˈwʌns/ (cụm từ): cùng một lúc. "Waiting in the queue at once" = cùng lúc nằm trong hàng đợi; "at once" cũng có nghĩa "ngay lập tức".
items.explanationEn: at once /ət ˈwʌns/ (phrase): at the same time. "Waiting in the queue at once" means simultaneously; "at once" can also mean "immediately".

items.question: Trong câu "Complexity of BFS: O(n) time (each node enqueued and dequeued once) and O(w) auxiliary space, where w is the maximum width of the tree — the largest number of nodes waiting in the queue at once.", từ "complexity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Complexity of BFS: O(n) time (each node enqueued and dequeued once) and O(w) auxiliary space, where w is the maximum width of the tree — the largest number of nodes waiting in the queue at once.", what does "complexity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: complexity /kəmˈpleksəti/ (danh từ): độ phức tạp (chi phí). "Time/space complexity" = độ phức tạp thời gian/bộ nhớ, thường viết bằng Big O.
items.explanationEn: complexity /kəmˈpleksəti/ (noun): the cost of an algorithm. "Time/space complexity" describes how cost grows with input, usually in Big O.

items.question: Trong câu "DFS follows one branch down to a leaf, then backs up and tries the next branch.", từ "leaf" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DFS follows one branch down to a leaf, then backs up and tries the next branch.", what does "leaf" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a flat green part of a plant
the top node of a tree
items.explanation: leaf /liːf/ (danh từ): nút lá (không có con). "Down to a leaf" = đi xuống tới nút lá; số nhiều là "leaves".
items.explanationEn: leaf /liːf/ (noun): a node with no children. "Down to a leaf" means reaching a node with no children; plural "leaves".

items.question: Trong câu "DFS follows one branch down to a leaf, then backs up and tries the next branch.", từ "back up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DFS follows one branch down to a leaf, then backs up and tries the next branch.", what does "back up" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to make a copy of data
to go back the way you came
items.explanation: back up /ˌbæk ˈʌp/ (cụm từ): quay ngược lên. "Backs up" ở đây = lùi lại nút cha (quay lui); trong IT "back up" thường là sao lưu.
items.explanationEn: back up /ˌbæk ˈʌp/ (phrase): to go back the way you came. "Backs up" here means returning to the parent; in IT "back up" usually means copying data.

items.question: Trong câu "Recursively, "handle a node" breaks into three jobs: visit the node (N), traverse the left subtree (L), traverse the right subtree (R).", từ "recursively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Recursively, "handle a node" breaks into three jobs: visit the node (N), traverse the left subtree (L), traverse the right subtree (R).", what does "recursively" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: recursively /rɪˈkɜːsɪvli/ (trạng từ): theo cách đệ quy. "Recursively" = hàm tự gọi lại chính nó trên bài toán nhỏ hơn; tính từ "recursive".
items.explanationEn: recursively /rɪˈkɜːsɪvli/ (adverb): by calling itself. "Recursively" means a function calls itself on a smaller problem; adjective "recursive".

items.question: Trong câu "Recursively, "handle a node" breaks into three jobs: visit the node (N), traverse the left subtree (L), traverse the right subtree (R).", từ "break into" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Recursively, "handle a node" breaks into three jobs: visit the node (N), traverse the left subtree (L), traverse the right subtree (R).", what does "break into" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: break into /ˈbreɪk ˈɪntuː/ (cụm từ): chia thành. "Breaks into three jobs" = tách thành ba việc; "break into a house" lại là đột nhập.
items.explanationEn: break into /ˈbreɪk ˈɪntuː/ (phrase): to divide into parts. "Breaks into three jobs" means splits into three tasks; "break into a house" means to burgle it.

items.question: Trong câu "Recursively, "handle a node" breaks into three jobs: visit the node (N), traverse the left subtree (L), traverse the right subtree (R).", từ "handle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Recursively, "handle a node" breaks into three jobs: visit the node (N), traverse the left subtree (L), traverse the right subtree (R).", what does "handle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: handle /ˈhændl/ (động từ): xử lý. "Handle a node / handle an error" = xử lý nút / xử lý lỗi; danh từ "handle" = tay cầm.
items.explanationEn: handle /ˈhændl/ (verb): to deal with. "Handle a node / an error" means dealing with it; the noun "handle" is a grip.

items.question: Trong câu "A visual trick: trace a line around the outside of the tree, starting at the root and going down its left side.", từ "visual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A visual trick: trace a line around the outside of the tree, starting at the root and going down its left side.", what does "visual" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: visual /ˈvɪʒuəl/ (tính từ): bằng hình ảnh. "A visual trick" = mẹo nhìn hình để nhớ; "visualize" = hình dung.
items.explanationEn: visual /ˈvɪʒuəl/ (adjective): related to seeing. "A visual trick" is a way to remember by picturing it; "visualize" means to picture.

items.question: Trong câu "A visual trick: trace a line around the outside of the tree, starting at the root and going down its left side.", từ "trace" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A visual trick: trace a line around the outside of the tree, starting at the root and going down its left side.", what does "trace" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: trace /treɪs/ (động từ): vẽ theo đường. "Trace a line around the tree" = vẽ một đường vòng quanh cây; "trace" cũng là lần theo từng bước chạy code.
items.explanationEn: trace /treɪs/ (verb): to draw along a line. "Trace a line around the tree" means draw along its outline; "trace" also means following code step by step.

items.question: Trong câu "Each node is passed three times — on its left, underneath it, on its right.", từ "underneath" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each node is passed three times — on its left, underneath it, on its right.", what does "underneath" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: underneath /ˌʌndəˈniːθ/ (giới từ): bên dưới. "Underneath it" = ngay bên dưới nút; đồng nghĩa với "below/beneath".
items.explanationEn: underneath /ˌʌndəˈniːθ/ (preposition): directly below. "Underneath it" means directly below the node; similar to "below" or "beneath".

items.question: Trong câu "Recording nodes when you pass their left side gives pre-order, underneath gives in-order, their right side gives post-order.", từ "record" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Recording nodes when you pass their left side gives pre-order, underneath gives in-order, their right side gives post-order.", what does "record" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: record /rɪˈkɔːd/ (động từ): ghi lại. "Record a node" = ghi nút vào kết quả; danh từ "record" /ˈrekɔːd/ = bản ghi.
items.explanationEn: record /rɪˈkɔːd/ (verb): to write down, to store. "Record a node" means adding it to the output; the noun "record" /ˈrekɔːd/ is an entry.

items.question: Trong câu "The base case is an empty subtree (null).", từ "base case" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The base case is an empty subtree (null).", what does "base case" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: base case /ˈbeɪs keɪs/ (cụm từ): trường hợp dừng đệ quy. Mọi hàm đệ quy cần "base case" để dừng, nếu không sẽ tràn call stack.
items.explanationEn: base case /ˈbeɪs keɪs/ (phrase): the case that stops recursion. Every recursive function needs a base case to stop, or it overflows the call stack.

items.question: Trong câu "It is used to copy or export/serialize a tree so it can be rebuilt.", từ "serialize" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is used to copy or export/serialize a tree so it can be rebuilt.", what does "serialize" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: serialize /ˈsɪəriəlaɪz/ (động từ): chuyển thành chuỗi lưu trữ. "Serialize a tree" = biến cây thành chuỗi để lưu/gửi; ngược lại là "deserialize".
items.explanationEn: serialize /ˈsɪəriəlaɪz/ (verb): to turn into storable text. "Serialize a tree" means turning it into a string to store or send; the reverse is "deserialize".

items.question: Trong câu "Written with a marker for every null child, pre-order describes the shape exactly:", từ "marker" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Written with a marker for every null child, pre-order describes the shape exactly:", what does "marker" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: marker /ˈmɑːkə(r)/ (danh từ): ký hiệu đánh dấu. "A marker for every null child" = ký hiệu (như #) cho mỗi con rỗng.
items.explanationEn: marker /ˈmɑːkə(r)/ (noun): a symbol that marks something. "A marker for every null child" is a symbol such as # standing for an empty child.

items.question: Trong câu "A reader rebuilds it the same way: read a token, create the node, then recursively build its left and right subtrees.", từ "token" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A reader rebuilds it the same way: read a token, create the node, then recursively build its left and right subtrees.", what does "token" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: token /ˈtəʊkən/ (danh từ): đơn vị ký hiệu. "Read a token" = đọc một phần tử của chuỗi (ví dụ "10" hoặc "#"); trong bảo mật "token" là mã xác thực.
items.explanationEn: token /ˈtəʊkən/ (noun): a single unit of text. "Read a token" means reading one piece of the string such as "10" or "#"; in security it is an access code.

items.question: Trong câu "For a BST, even plain pre-order without markers works: inserting its values in that order reproduces the same tree.", từ "plain" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For a BST, even plain pre-order without markers works: inserting its values in that order reproduces the same tree.", what does "plain" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: plain /pleɪn/ (tính từ): đơn thuần, thông thường. "Plain pre-order" = pre-order bình thường không thêm ký hiệu; "plain text" = văn bản thuần.
items.explanationEn: plain /pleɪn/ (adjective): simple, with nothing added. "Plain pre-order" means pre-order with nothing extra; "plain text" is text without formatting.

items.question: Trong câu "For a BST, even plain pre-order without markers works: inserting its values in that order reproduces the same tree.", từ "reproduce" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For a BST, even plain pre-order without markers works: inserting its values in that order reproduces the same tree.", what does "reproduce" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reproduce /ˌriːprəˈdjuːs/ (động từ): tạo lại y hệt. "Reproduces the same tree" = dựng lại đúng cây cũ; "reproduce a bug" = tái hiện lỗi.
items.explanationEn: reproduce /ˌriːprəˈdjuːs/ (verb): to create again exactly. "Reproduces the same tree" means building an identical tree; "reproduce a bug" means making it happen again.

items.question: Trong câu "When to use it: on a BST, in-order visits values in ascending sorted order, because everything in the left subtree is smaller than the node and everything in the right subtree is larger.", từ "ascending" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When to use it: on a BST, in-order visits values in ascending sorted order, because everything in the left subtree is smaller than the node and everything in the right subtree is larger.", what does "ascending" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ascending /əˈsendɪŋ/ (tính từ): tăng dần. "Ascending sorted order" = thứ tự tăng dần; đối lập "descending".
items.explanationEn: ascending /əˈsendɪŋ/ (adjective): going from small to large. "Ascending sorted order" means smallest first; the opposite is "descending".

items.question: Trong câu "Validate a BST — the in-order sequence must be strictly increasing.", từ "strictly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Validate a BST — the in-order sequence must be strictly increasing.", what does "strictly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: strictly /ˈstrɪktli/ (trạng từ): một cách ngặt (không bằng). "Strictly increasing" = tăng ngặt, phần tử sau luôn lớn hơn (không được bằng) phần tử trước.
items.explanationEn: strictly /ˈstrɪktli/ (adverb): with no equal values. "Strictly increasing" means each value is greater than the previous, never equal.

items.question: Trong câu "For validation you don't even need the array: remember only the previously visited value and fail as soon as a node is not larger than it — O(n) time, O(h) space.", từ "as soon as" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For validation you don't even need the array: remember only the previously visited value and fail as soon as a node is not larger than it — O(n) time, O(h) space.", what does "as soon as" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: as soon as /əz ˈsuːn əz/ (cụm từ): ngay khi. "Fail as soon as…" = báo lỗi ngay khi gặp điều kiện, không cần duyệt tiếp.
items.explanationEn: as soon as /əz ˈsuːn əz/ (phrase): the moment that. "Fail as soon as…" means stopping the moment the condition appears.

items.question: Trong câu "When to use it: a node is handled only after both its subtrees are finished, so post-order fits any problem where the answer for a node depends on answers from its children:", từ "fit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When to use it: a node is handled only after both its subtrees are finished, so post-order fits any problem where the answer for a node depends on answers from its children:", what does "fit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: fit /fɪt/ (động từ): phù hợp với. "Post-order fits any problem where…" = post-order hợp với bài toán kiểu…; "fit into memory" = vừa bộ nhớ.
items.explanationEn: fit /fɪt/ (verb): to be suitable for. "Post-order fits any problem where…" means it suits such problems; "fit into memory" means be small enough.

items.question: Trong câu "When to use it: a node is handled only after both its subtrees are finished, so post-order fits any problem where the answer for a node depends on answers from its children:", từ "depend on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When to use it: a node is handled only after both its subtrees are finished, so post-order fits any problem where the answer for a node depends on answers from its children:", what does "depend on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: depend on /dɪˈpend ɒn/ (cụm từ): phụ thuộc vào. "Depends on answers from its children" = kết quả của nút được quyết định bởi kết quả của các con.
items.explanationEn: depend on /dɪˈpend ɒn/ (phrase): to be decided by. "Depends on answers from its children" means the node's result is decided by its children's results.

items.question: Trong câu "Evaluating an expression tree: compute operands before applying the operator.", từ "evaluate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Evaluating an expression tree: compute operands before applying the operator.", what does "evaluate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to work out the value of
items.explanation: evaluate /ɪˈvæljueɪt/ (động từ): tính giá trị. "Evaluate an expression" = tính ra giá trị biểu thức; "evaluate a candidate" lại là đánh giá ứng viên.
items.explanationEn: evaluate /ɪˈvæljueɪt/ (verb): to work out the value of. "Evaluate an expression" means computing its value; "evaluate a candidate" means judging them.

items.question: Trong câu "Evaluating an expression tree: compute operands before applying the operator.", từ "operand" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Evaluating an expression tree: compute operands before applying the operator.", what does "operand" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a value an operator acts on
items.explanation: operand /ˈɒpərænd/ (danh từ): toán hạng. Trong "3 + 4", 3 và 4 là "operands", dấu + là "operator".
items.explanationEn: operand /ˈɒpərænd/ (noun): a value an operator acts on. In "3 + 4", 3 and 4 are the operands and + is the operator.

items.question: Trong câu "Evaluating an expression tree: compute operands before applying the operator.", từ "apply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Evaluating an expression tree: compute operands before applying the operator.", what does "apply" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to ask formally for a job
items.explanation: apply /əˈplaɪ/ (động từ): thực hiện (phép toán). "Apply the operator" = thực hiện phép toán lên các toán hạng; "apply for a job" = nộp đơn xin việc.
items.explanationEn: apply /əˈplaɪ/ (verb): to use on something. "Apply the operator" means using it on the operands; "apply for a job" means requesting it formally.

items.question: Trong câu "Some books count edges instead, giving 2; state your convention in an interview.", từ "edge" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Some books count edges instead, giving 2; state your convention in an interview.", what does "edge" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the sharp side of a blade
items.explanation: edge /edʒ/ (danh từ): cạnh (nối hai nút). "Count edges" = đếm số cạnh; cây n nút có n − 1 cạnh; "edge case" = trường hợp biên.
items.explanationEn: edge /edʒ/ (noun): a link between two nodes. "Count edges" means counting links; a tree with n nodes has n − 1 edges; "edge case" is a boundary case.

items.question: Trong câu "Some books count edges instead, giving 2; state your convention in an interview.", từ "convention" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Some books count edges instead, giving 2; state your convention in an interview.", what does "convention" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: convention /kənˈvenʃn/ (danh từ): quy ước. "State your convention" = nói rõ bạn dùng quy ước nào (đếm nút hay cạnh); "naming convention" = quy ước đặt tên.
items.explanationEn: convention /kənˈvenʃn/ (noun): an agreed way of doing. "State your convention" means saying which rule you use; "naming convention" is an agreed naming style.

items.question: Trong câu "For the expression (3 + 4) * 2, the three DFS orders produce the three classic notations:", từ "notation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For the expression (3 + 4) * 2, the three DFS orders produce the three classic notations:", what does "notation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: notation /nəʊˈteɪʃn/ (danh từ): ký pháp, cách viết. "Prefix/infix/postfix notation" = ký pháp tiền tố/trung tố/hậu tố; "Big O notation" cũng dùng từ này.
items.explanationEn: notation /nəʊˈteɪʃn/ (noun): a system of symbols. "Prefix/infix/postfix notation" are ways of writing expressions; "Big O notation" uses the same word.

items.question: Trong câu "Recursion uses the call stack implicitly.", từ "implicitly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Recursion uses the call stack implicitly.", what does "implicitly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: implicitly /ɪmˈplɪsɪtli/ (trạng từ): một cách ngầm. "Uses the call stack implicitly" = dùng ngầm, bạn không tự tạo stack; đối lập "explicitly".
items.explanationEn: implicitly /ɪmˈplɪsɪtli/ (adverb): without being stated. "Uses the call stack implicitly" means you never create it yourself; the opposite is "explicitly".

items.question: Trong câu "On a very deep tree (a skewed tree with 100,000 nodes, for example) this throws RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded; JavaScript engines allow only on the order of ten thousand frames.", từ "skewed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On a very deep tree (a skewed tree with 100,000 nodes, for example) this throws RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded; JavaScript engines allow only on the order of ten thousand frames.", what does "skewed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: skewed /skjuːd/ (tính từ): lệch về một phía. "A skewed tree" = cây lệch, mỗi nút chỉ có một con nên giống danh sách liên kết.
items.explanationEn: skewed /skjuːd/ (adjective): leaning to one side. "A skewed tree" has one child per node, so it looks like a linked list.

items.question: Trong câu "On a very deep tree (a skewed tree with 100,000 nodes, for example) this throws RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded; JavaScript engines allow only on the order of ten thousand frames.", từ "exceed" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On a very deep tree (a skewed tree with 100,000 nodes, for example) this throws RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded; JavaScript engines allow only on the order of ten thousand frames.", what does "exceed" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: exceed /ɪkˈsiːd/ (động từ): vượt quá. "Maximum call stack size exceeded" = vượt quá kích thước tối đa của call stack.
items.explanationEn: exceed /ɪkˈsiːd/ (verb): to go beyond a limit. "Maximum call stack size exceeded" means the limit of the call stack was passed.

items.question: Trong câu "On a very deep tree (a skewed tree with 100,000 nodes, for example) this throws RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded; JavaScript engines allow only on the order of ten thousand frames.", từ "on the order of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On a very deep tree (a skewed tree with 100,000 nodes, for example) this throws RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded; JavaScript engines allow only on the order of ten thousand frames.", what does "on the order of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on the order of /ɒn ði ˈɔːdər əv/ (cụm từ): vào khoảng, cỡ chừng. "On the order of ten thousand" = cỡ khoảng mười nghìn, chỉ độ lớn ước chừng.
items.explanationEn: on the order of /ɒn ði ˈɔːdər əv/ (phrase): roughly, about. "On the order of ten thousand" gives a rough size, not an exact number.

items.question: Trong câu "The fix is to manage a stack yourself on the heap.", từ "heap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The fix is to manage a stack yourself on the heap.", what does "heap" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: heap /hiːp/ (danh từ): vùng nhớ heap. "On the heap" = trong vùng nhớ động, lớn hơn nhiều so với call stack; "heap" cũng là tên một cấu trúc dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: heap /hiːp/ (noun): memory for dynamic objects. "On the heap" means in dynamic memory, far larger than the call stack; "heap" is also a data structure.

items.question: Trong câu "In-order: slide left as far as possible, pushing nodes; pop one, visit it, then move to its right child.", từ "slide" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In-order: slide left as far as possible, pushing nodes; pop one, visit it, then move to its right child.", what does "slide" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: slide /slaɪd/ (động từ): trượt, di chuyển dần. "Slide left" = cứ đi dần sang con trái; "sliding window" = cửa sổ trượt.
items.explanationEn: slide /slaɪd/ (verb): to move smoothly along. "Slide left" means keep moving down to the left child; "sliding window" is a related pattern.

items.question: Trong câu "Post-order iteratively: run the pre-order loop with the push order swapped (N → R → L) and reverse the result, which gives L → R → N.", từ "iteratively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Post-order iteratively: run the pre-order loop with the push order swapped (N → R → L) and reverse the result, which gives L → R → N.", what does "iteratively" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: iteratively /ˈɪtərətɪvli/ (trạng từ): theo cách lặp. "Iteratively" = dùng vòng lặp thay vì đệ quy; tính từ "iterative".
items.explanationEn: iteratively /ˈɪtərətɪvli/ (adverb): by using a loop. "Iteratively" means using a loop instead of recursion; adjective "iterative".

items.question: Trong câu "Post-order iteratively: run the pre-order loop with the push order swapped (N → R → L) and reverse the result, which gives L → R → N.", từ "swap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Post-order iteratively: run the pre-order loop with the push order swapped (N → R → L) and reverse the result, which gives L → R → N.", what does "swap" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: swap /swɒp/ (động từ): hoán đổi. "The push order swapped" = đổi chỗ thứ tự push; "swap two elements" = hoán đổi hai phần tử.
items.explanationEn: swap /swɒp/ (verb): to exchange places. "The push order swapped" means the two pushes change places; "swap two elements" is common.

items.question: Trong câu "All three remain O(n) time and O(h) auxiliary space.", từ "remain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "All three remain O(n) time and O(h) auxiliary space.", what does "remain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: remain /rɪˈmeɪn/ (động từ): vẫn giữ nguyên. "All three remain O(n)" = cả ba vẫn là O(n); "remain + tính từ" = vẫn còn như thế.
items.explanationEn: remain /rɪˈmeɪn/ (verb): to stay the same. "All three remain O(n)" means they are still O(n); "remain + adjective" means stay that way.

items.question: Trong câu "Many interview problems need to know where one level ends: print each level on its own line, right-side view, average per level, minimum depth.", từ "average" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many interview problems need to know where one level ends: print each level on its own line, right-side view, average per level, minimum depth.", what does "average" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: average /ˈævərɪdʒ/ (danh từ): giá trị trung bình. "Average per level" = trung bình cộng các giá trị trên mỗi tầng.
items.explanationEn: average /ˈævərɪdʒ/ (noun): the mean value. "Average per level" is the mean of the values on each level.

items.question: Trong câu "Many interview problems need to know where one level ends: print each level on its own line, right-side view, average per level, minimum depth.", từ "per" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many interview problems need to know where one level ends: print each level on its own line, right-side view, average per level, minimum depth.", what does "per" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: per /pɜː(r)/ (giới từ): cho mỗi. "Per level" = cho mỗi tầng; hay gặp "per second", "per request".
items.explanationEn: per /pɜː(r)/ (preposition): for each. "Per level" means for each level; common in "per second" or "per request".

items.question: Trong câu "Process the tree one whole level at a time:", từ "at a time" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Process the tree one whole level at a time:", what does "at a time" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at a time /ət ə ˈtaɪm/ (cụm từ): mỗi lần (một). "One level at a time" = xử lý từng tầng một, xong tầng này mới sang tầng khác.
items.explanationEn: at a time /ət ə ˈtaɪm/ (phrase): in each single step. "One level at a time" means finishing one level before moving to the next.

items.question: Trong câu "No shift is involved, so this is truly O(n) time, and only two levels are held at once, so it is O(w) auxiliary space.", từ "involve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No shift is involved, so this is truly O(n) time, and only two levels are held at once, so it is O(w) auxiliary space.", what does "involve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: involve /ɪnˈvɒlv/ (động từ): có liên quan, dùng đến. "No shift is involved" = không dùng tới shift; "involve doing something" = bao gồm việc gì.
items.explanationEn: involve /ɪnˈvɒlv/ (verb): to include as a part. "No shift is involved" means shift is not used; "involve doing something" means include it.

items.question: Trong câu "No shift is involved, so this is truly O(n) time, and only two levels are held at once, so it is O(w) auxiliary space.", từ "truly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No shift is involved, so this is truly O(n) time, and only two levels are held at once, so it is O(w) auxiliary space.", what does "truly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: truly /ˈtruːli/ (trạng từ): thực sự. "Truly O(n)" = thực sự là O(n), khác với bản dùng shift chỉ trông như O(n).
items.explanationEn: truly /ˈtruːli/ (adverb): really, genuinely. "Truly O(n)" means genuinely O(n), unlike the shift version that only looks like it.

items.question: Trong câu "Because BFS reaches nodes in order of depth, it can stop early at the first match — the first leaf found is the minimum depth, and the first matching node is the shallowest one.", từ "reach" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Because BFS reaches nodes in order of depth, it can stop early at the first match — the first leaf found is the minimum depth, and the first matching node is the shallowest one.", what does "reach" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reach /riːtʃ/ (động từ): đi tới, chạm tới. "Reaches nodes in order of depth" = đi tới các nút theo thứ tự độ sâu.
items.explanationEn: reach /riːtʃ/ (verb): to arrive at. "Reaches nodes in order of depth" means arriving at nodes level by level.

items.question: Trong câu "Because BFS reaches nodes in order of depth, it can stop early at the first match — the first leaf found is the minimum depth, and the first matching node is the shallowest one.", từ "match" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Because BFS reaches nodes in order of depth, it can stop early at the first match — the first leaf found is the minimum depth, and the first matching node is the shallowest one.", what does "match" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: match /mætʃ/ (danh từ): kết quả khớp. "The first match" = phần tử đầu tiên khớp điều kiện tìm; động từ "match" = khớp.
items.explanationEn: match /mætʃ/ (noun): something that fits a search. "The first match" is the first item meeting the search condition; the verb "match" means fit.

items.question: Trong câu "Because BFS reaches nodes in order of depth, it can stop early at the first match — the first leaf found is the minimum depth, and the first matching node is the shallowest one.", từ "shallow" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Because BFS reaches nodes in order of depth, it can stop early at the first match — the first leaf found is the minimum depth, and the first matching node is the shallowest one.", what does "shallow" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: shallow /ˈʃæləʊ/ (tính từ): nông, gần gốc. "The shallowest node" = nút nông nhất, gần gốc nhất; "shallow copy" = sao chép nông.
items.explanationEn: shallow /ˈʃæləʊ/ (adjective): not deep. "The shallowest node" is the one closest to the root; "shallow copy" is a related term.

items.question: Trong câu "DFS cannot guarantee that without exploring everything.", từ "guarantee" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DFS cannot guarantee that without exploring everything.", what does "guarantee" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: guarantee /ˌɡærənˈtiː/ (động từ): đảm bảo chắc chắn. "Cannot guarantee that" = không thể đảm bảo điều đó; danh từ "guarantee" = sự bảo đảm.
items.explanationEn: guarantee /ˌɡærənˈtiː/ (verb): to promise for certain. "Cannot guarantee that" means it cannot be certain; the noun "guarantee" is a promise.

items.question: Trong câu "For a perfect tree of about a million nodes, BFS keeps around 500,000 nodes in its queue while recursive DFS keeps only about 20 frames.", từ "frame" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For a perfect tree of about a million nodes, BFS keeps around 500,000 nodes in its queue while recursive DFS keeps only about 20 frames.", what does "frame" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: one function call on the stack
items.explanation: frame /freɪm/ (danh từ): khung lời gọi hàm. "20 frames" = 20 lời gọi hàm đang nằm trên call stack ("stack frame").
items.explanationEn: frame /freɪm/ (noun): one function call on the stack. "20 frames" means 20 function calls currently on the call stack ("stack frames").

items.question: Trong câu "For a skewed tree it is the opposite.", từ "opposite" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For a skewed tree it is the opposite.", what does "opposite" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: opposite /ˈɒpəzɪt/ (danh từ): điều ngược lại. "It is the opposite" = kết quả đảo ngược; cây lệch thì BFS tốn O(1), DFS tốn O(n).
items.explanationEn: opposite /ˈɒpəzɪt/ (noun): the reverse. "It is the opposite" means the result is reversed: on a skewed tree BFS is O(1) and DFS O(n).

items.question: Trong câu "These same two ideas return in graphs (topic 18): BFS with a queue, DFS with a stack, plus a visited set because graphs can contain cycles — trees cannot.", từ "contain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These same two ideas return in graphs (topic 18): BFS with a queue, DFS with a stack, plus a visited set because graphs can contain cycles — trees cannot.", what does "contain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: contain /kənˈteɪn/ (động từ): chứa, có. "Graphs can contain cycles" = đồ thị có thể có chu trình; "contain" cũng có nghĩa kiềm chế.
items.explanationEn: contain /kənˈteɪn/ (verb): to have inside. "Graphs can contain cycles" means cycles may exist in them; "contain" can also mean hold back.

items.question: Trong câu "These same two ideas return in graphs (topic 18): BFS with a queue, DFS with a stack, plus a visited set because graphs can contain cycles — trees cannot.", từ "cycle" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These same two ideas return in graphs (topic 18): BFS with a queue, DFS with a stack, plus a visited set because graphs can contain cycles — trees cannot.", what does "cycle" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a path back to its start
items.explanation: cycle /ˈsaɪkl/ (danh từ): chu trình (đồ thị). "Contain cycles" = có đường đi quay về chính nút ban đầu; vì vậy duyệt đồ thị cần tập "visited".
items.explanationEn: cycle /ˈsaɪkl/ (noun): a path back to its start. "Contain cycles" means some path leads back to its start, so graph traversal needs a visited set.

items.question: Trong câu "Deep trees can overflow the call stack; convert DFS to an explicit stack.", từ "overflow" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Deep trees can overflow the call stack; convert DFS to an explicit stack.", what does "overflow" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: overflow /ˌəʊvəˈfləʊ/ (động từ): tràn (vượt sức chứa). "Overflow the call stack" = làm tràn call stack; danh từ "stack overflow" = lỗi tràn ngăn xếp.
items.explanationEn: overflow /ˌəʊvəˈfləʊ/ (verb): to go past capacity. "Overflow the call stack" means using more than it can hold; the noun is "stack overflow".

items.question: Trong câu "Deep trees can overflow the call stack; convert DFS to an explicit stack.", từ "convert" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Deep trees can overflow the call stack; convert DFS to an explicit stack.", what does "convert" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: convert /kənˈvɜːt/ (động từ): chuyển đổi. "Convert DFS to an explicit stack" = viết lại DFS dùng stack tự quản lý; cấu trúc "convert A to/into B".
items.explanationEn: convert /kənˈvɜːt/ (verb): to change into another form. "Convert DFS to an explicit stack" means rewriting it with your own stack; pattern "convert A to/into B".

items.question: Trong câu "Deep trees can overflow the call stack; convert DFS to an explicit stack.", từ "explicit" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Deep trees can overflow the call stack; convert DFS to an explicit stack.", what does "explicit" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: explicit /ɪkˈsplɪsɪt/ (tính từ): tường minh, rõ ràng. "An explicit stack" = stack do bạn tự tạo trong code; đối lập "implicit".
items.explanationEn: explicit /ɪkˈsplɪsɪt/ (adjective): clearly stated, visible. "An explicit stack" is one you create in code yourself; the opposite is "implicit".

items.question: Trong câu "A tree is non-linear, so we pick a strategy: breadth-first (queue) or depth-first (stack).", từ "breadth" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A tree is non-linear, so we pick a strategy: breadth-first (queue) or depth-first (stack).", what does "breadth" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: breadth /bredθ/ (danh từ): chiều rộng. "Breadth-first" = ưu tiên chiều rộng (duyệt hết một tầng rồi xuống); đừng nhầm với "breath" (hơi thở).
items.explanationEn: breadth /bredθ/ (noun): the distance side to side. "Breadth-first" means covering a whole level before going deeper; do not confuse it with "breath".

items.question: Trong câu "Time is always O(n); memory depends on the tree's shape — width for BFS, height for DFS.", từ "shape" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Time is always O(n); memory depends on the tree's shape — width for BFS, height for DFS.", what does "shape" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: shape /ʃeɪp/ (danh từ): hình dạng. "The tree's shape" = hình dạng cây (rộng hay sâu), quyết định bộ nhớ cần dùng; "in good shape" = khoẻ mạnh.
items.explanationEn: shape /ʃeɪp/ (noun): the outline or form. "The tree's shape" is whether it is wide or deep, which decides memory use; "in good shape" means healthy.
